title: Warm Citrusy Vietnamese Pork Goi Cuon
description: A refreshing and healthy Vietnamese dish featuring citrusy pork and glassy jelly, perfect for a post-workout snack, this diabetic-friendly recipe uses air-fry method to reduce fat content.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, lime juice, fish sauce, rice vinegar, and grated ginger to make the marinade.
Add the sliced pork to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook in the air fryer for 10 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a small saucepan, combine agar agar and water, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the agar agar is dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
To assemble the goi cuon, fill a large bowl with warm water.
Soak a rice paper sheet in the warm water for 10 seconds, then remove and place on a flat surface.
Arrange a few slices of the cooked pork, some chopped mint and basil leaves, and a spoonful of the cooled agar agar mixture in the center of the rice paper.
Fold the bottom half of the rice paper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the goi cuon to form a tight cylinder.
